instance_host.title: Instance Host
instance_host.description: Reporting instance host used for the OAuth token endpoint.

options.tooltip: The per-instance reporting host, e.g. `mycompany.medallia.com`. The token endpoint is `https://<instance host>/oauth/<company name>/token`. Ask your Medallia administrator if unsure.

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: The company/tenant segment of the OAuth token path.

options.tooltip: The `<companyName>` path segment in the token URL. Some instances double the company name in the API host, so it is supplied separately and never derived automatically.

api_host.title: API Host
api_host.description: The Query API gateway host (the `.apis.medallia.com` host).

options.tooltip: The API gateway host, e.g. `mycompany.apis.medallia.com`. Query requests go to `https://<API host>/data/v0/query`. Sandbox hosts differ; supply the exact host issued for your instance.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID issued by your Medallia administrator.

#client_secret.title: Client Secret
#client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret issued by your Medallia administrator.
